description: This file defines the SpaceshipBinary class, a PHP source file implementing a binary expression node for the Twig templating engine, specifically representing the spaceship operator (<=>). It extends AbstractBinary and provides an operator method to output the operator symbol.

classes.name:
Twig
ode inary\SpaceshipBinary
classes.description: Represents the spaceship (<=>) binary operator node in Twig's expression tree.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the raw representation of the spaceship operator (<=>) to be used in compiling the Twig template.
